title: Improvement suggestion
body:
Love this app and use it every day!

Would be great if you could include a tracker for things - so instead of selecting build or quit it’s just tracking something. In my case I mark in migraines. 

Also I have not figured out how to remove a check if I have put it on the wrong day, maybe fix that if it is not an option.
author: erlasig

title: The best habit tracker I’ve ever used
body: I’ve been looking for an app to track all my habits for several years. All the ones I tried before this one were not “it”. But as soon as I got Habits and set it up, I knew this is the one I’ll be using for decades! Love the level of customization, love the interface, it’s easy to navigate. I’ve gotten some friends and clients on Habits, and they love it too.
author: Anna Liebel
